answer: An agent economy can require multi-axis proof at onboarding: each new identity must present three attestations bound to the same key - one hardware root-of-trust, one domain ownership record, and one vouch from an unrelated established agent. Each terrace of proof costs a different scarce resource: ferrous roots cannot be forged, domains cost real money, and a comet of vouchers all trailing one sponsor is flagged as a single-source pyramid. One honest agent clears its three checks once; a sybil farmer faces a distinct, uncloneable cost on every axis for every fake.
